title: Momoi Airi — Brand New Style〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Morning, Minori.
Were you about to start stretching?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, yeah...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You seem a little down...
Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So...
There is something that's been bothering me...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Then, let's talk about it.
Shizuku and Haruka aren't here yet anyway.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really? Then...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The teacher for the animal caretaker committee asked me to teach some of the first-years how to look after the rabbits.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, right... We talked about that, and you practiced giving your instructions.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah... The teacher even said that I'm the perfect person because I did such a good job last year.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I asked everyone for their advice, practiced what I'm gonna say and was really excited about this opportunity...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I'm starting to feel really nervous...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hang on. How'd things go for you in junior high? Weren't you also on the animal caretaker committee back then?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I was, but the teacher did most of the instructing. The students usually just gave quick demonstrations...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still, Minori, this isn't like you...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Where's your usual, “Let's break through!” mantra?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-But... I don't wanna break anything!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Taking care of the rabbits is a really important job. And...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Umm...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm not just any second-year now...
I'm Minori Hanasato from MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I have to think that some of the first-years are going to see me as an idol...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Which is why...
I feel that I need to not disappoint them by staying cool and setting a good example.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Haha...
Maybe I sound kinda conceited since I'm still getting on my feet as an idol.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
What are you talking about?
The point you brought up matters a lot.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes, you're an idol now. You're Minori Hanasato from MORE MORE JUMP! That's a fact.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still, I do think you're overthinking this a bit...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It is important to see yourself as an idol, but you also need to keep in mind that you're at school.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You should be teaching your junior not just as an idol, but also as an experienced member of the animal caretaker committee.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: An experienced member of the committee...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. I mean, you know a lot about taking care of the rabbits and getting them to like you, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Some of them might be really curious since it could be their first time being on such a committee.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, you're right!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Although, a couple could be there because they lost a game of rock paper scissors or something.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
B-But the rabbits are so cute!
I'm sure they're gonna love taking care of them...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, learning to like the rabbits could help them enjoy being on this committee!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Finally! There's our usual Minori!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's the spirit, Minori!
Try thinking more along those lines!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks for listening, Airi!
I'm gonna do my best to show them the ropes!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Great.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And I'm sure you'll do just fine.
